title: Review findings
description: The critic's output. Nothing validated this before, and four real review files had already drifted apart: review-r13.json is missing `round`, `category` and `hypothesis` that review-r15.json has. A dispatcher reading an undeclared shape routes on fields that may not be there.

round.description: Recommended. Without it the file's name is the only record of which round it is.

profile.description: Device profile judged, e.g. `phone`. Recommended: a set judged at the wrong profile has passed review before.

tier.description: Quality tier the artefacts were produced at. Five rounds were once reviewed at the wrong tier.

nativeResolution.description: Resolution the reviewer judged at. A downscaled view has produced a false blocker.

verdict.description: Default FAIL. A verdict of PASS closes the review workstream only, never the product criteria.

blindComparison.description: Shown unlabelled beside the reference, which would a stranger pick, and the specific reason. 'Looks less detailed' is not a reason.

shot.description: Which artefact(s). Prose lists such as 'hero, torii, wide (all three)' occur in real files and cannot be joined against a manifest key; an array would be better.

problem.description: The observed symptom, with the measurement. Symptom calls have held up 6/6 across measured rounds.

why.description: Why it matters at the bar being held.

owner.description: Repo-relative path of the file that owns the fix. Must resolve in the ownership map or the finding lands in `unrouted`.

fix.description: A verifiable target, stated as a number and the command that reads it.

hypothesis.description: The proposed mechanism, kept separate from `problem` on purpose. Mechanism guesses were wrong 4/4 across measured rounds, so this must be disproved before it is acted on, and the disproof reported as a result.
